ONB-01.title: Welcome screen, privacy promise, single CTA « Commencer »

ONB-04.notes: Android: rings 1-4 all reachable and driven (SUG-AND-002 fixed the ring-3/4 overflow bug); the radial canvas (SUG-AND-014) renders by default and is asserted via the « moi » content description.

ONB-05.title: Classification data transmitted only to the user's own account; never logged, never in another user's response
ONB-05.notes: Wire-level assertion via network mocks in platform unit suites + playbook §6 privacy audit (wire audit). Not driveable from the UI layer. ⚠️ Transitional (ADR-001): the shipped code and these tests still assert the pre-2026-08-16 on-device-vault behaviour, which remains correct until the migration. Retitle/reclassify in the migration PR, not before.

FCH-09.title: Stored classification values are stable identifiers, not display copy
FCH-09.notes: ADR-001 stage 0b. Storage representation, not user-visible behaviour — the UI renders the same French labels before and after, which is why both E2E suites are unchanged and this is unit-covered rather than automated. iOS: ClassificationValuesTests. Android: ClassificationValuesTest, which adds the NFC-normalisation case Swift gets for free (Kotlin compares UTF-16 code units, so an NFD-encoded legacy token would not migrate).

IDT-01.title: Phone-OTP identity; server stores phoneHash only
IDT-01.notes: Mobile OTP round-trip automated against the live dev API; the phoneHash-only storage guarantee is an apps/api integration + DB-audit assertion.

IDT-02.title: JWT access + rotating refresh; reuse detection revokes family
IDT-02.notes: Refresh rotation + reuse detection not yet implemented server-side (no /auth/refresh endpoint) — no test exists yet. Reclass to api-integration when the FS-07 backend session work lands. Only the refresh-token-rejected-as-access case is covered (apps/api vault.test.ts). At-rest protection of both tokens IS covered on-device by KeystoreTokenStoreTest (SUG-AND-006, 2026-08-16): round-trip, not-plaintext-at-rest, distinct ciphertexts, fail-closed on an undecryptable value. The class stays not-e2e-verifiable because the OTHER half of IDT-02 — refresh rotation and reuse-detection family revocation — is not implemented yet (SUG-API-002); promote to automated only when that ships and is driven end-to-end.

IDT-03.title: OTP throttling per phoneHash/IP; single-use, ≤5 min codes
IDT-03.notes: Rate-limit behavior — deliberately not driven from a device (abusive request volume). Per-phoneHash throttle and single-use are tested (apps/api auth.test.ts); the per-IP half of IDT-03 is not implemented or tested yet.

IDT-04.title: In-app account deletion → cascade erasure, 7-day grace
IDT-04.notes: No native deletion UI exists yet (outside Waves 1–3 scope); cascade erasure has no endpoint or test yet (FS-07 in progress); add the apps/api integration test with the deletion endpoint. Reclass to automated when the UI lands.

IDT-05.title: Multi-device: any authenticated device syncs the same server-held state (no key transfer, no recovery phrase)
IDT-05.notes: Out of POC scope by spec (⚠️ ASSUMPTION); no surface exists.

IDT-06.title: Hashed contact discovery; boolean-only responses
IDT-06.notes: Hash-before-network is unit/wire covered; response-shape guarantees will be apps/api tests — the discovery endpoint does not exist yet (STATUS: missing). Import UI path exercised by onboarding E2E.

IDT-07.title: Non-member links + invite via web landing; pending links resolve on join
IDT-07.notes: No contact-link endpoints or web landing exist yet; reclass when FS-07 discovery/invite work lands. Mobile half is FCH-08 (automated).

IDT-08.title: Directional private links; no “X added you”, ever
IDT-08.notes: Asserted server-side: no such event/notification payload exists (playbook §6 non-observability audit).

IDT-09.title: Opaque single-purpose invite tokens; landing reveals displayName only after validation
IDT-09.notes: Web scope (apps/web tests) — no mobile surface.

VLT-01.title: Classification stored server-side in Postgres as typed columns; TLS in transit, encrypted at rest
VLT-01.notes: E2E exercises the real encrypt/decrypt path via the legacy-blob seed hooks (also the pre-FS-03 backward-compat regression guard); full crypto properties live in the cross-platform vector unit tests (docs/migration/vault-test-vectors.json). Recovery-phrase backup is IDT-05/VLT-05 territory. SUG-IOS-004 (iOS-only so far) added the undecryptable-vault honest-state guard: `VaultError.unreadable` + `CarteViewModel.loadState`, unit-tested directly (`VaultTests` + `CarteLoadStateTests`, run by `xcrun swift test`) and via a corrupt-blob XCUITest seed hook. Only XCUITests belong in the `tests` arrays above: `scripts/e2e-report.mjs` joins them against the `SwabAppUITests` xcresult bundle, so a SwiftPM unit-test name listed there is a guaranteed drift-guard failure — an Android AND-004 equivalent already landed against the crash-loop half of the same bug. ⚠️ Transitional (ADR-001, 2026-08-16): the named tests verify the SUPERSEDED on-device encrypted-vault implementation, which is still what ships. They stay green and must not be deleted before the migration; replace them with tests of the server-side behaviour in the client-stage PR, and reclassify then.

VLT-02.title: Typed per-user resource endpoints for classification data (was: dumb blob + version/409)
VLT-02.notes: Blob/version semantics — apps/api integration + client-side unit tests of the sync engine. ⚠️ Transitional (ADR-001, 2026-08-16): the named tests verify the SUPERSEDED on-device encrypted-vault implementation, which is still what ships. They stay green and must not be deleted before the migration; replace them with tests of the server-side behaviour in the client-stage PR, and reclassify then.

VLT-03.title: Server may read classification to serve the product, but never logs it or exposes it to another user
VLT-03.notes: The wire-level privacy-invariant test in apps/api; re-verified on every schema change (playbook §6). ⚠️ Transitional (ADR-001, 2026-08-16): the named tests verify the SUPERSEDED on-device encrypted-vault implementation, which is still what ships. They stay green and must not be deleted before the migration; replace them with tests of the server-side behaviour in the client-stage PR, and reclassify then.

VLT-04.title: Local cache for offline reads + queued writes; cache never authoritative
VLT-04.notes: Two halves, verified differently. Offline reads: exercised on both platforms by every map/fiche E2E flow, which runs off local state. Sync triggers: iOS implements all three (post-onboarding, app background, ≥30s-debounced write burst) in SwabCore.SyncScheduler, unit-covered by SwabCoreTests.SyncSchedulerTests (test_VLT04_* / test_ONB05_beforeActivation_*) through injected now/sleep seams — not E2E-automated, because a 30s debounce and a real background push are not observable from XCUITest without making the suite time-dependent. Android has NO trigger implementation yet (SUG-AND-001 open): its vault is still pushed exactly once, at the end of onboarding, so `unit-covered` there covers the offline-read half only. Corrected 2026-08-22 (SUG-IOS-002) — the previous note claimed trigger scheduling was unit-covered on both platforms when neither had a single trigger test.
